rss_method: unchanged release executable; wait4 kernel max RSS and libproc taskinfo/childpid sum sampled every 2ms plus API time; no ps subprocess. A sample traverses processes sequentially, so tree values are approximate sums, not atomic physical-memory peaks; shared pages can be counted repeatedly. The monitor parent is excluded. wait4 max RSS is saved as OS reported usage, not summed concurrent tree RSS. One discarded warmup per case, 3 shuffled measured rounds, seed20261110. Each CLI invocation has isolated TMPDIR. All output to files. No timing conclusions from monitored runs.
rss_api: proc_pidinfo PROC_PIDTASKINFO=4; proc_taskinfo from macOS SDK sys/proc_info.h, 96bytes; proc_listchildpids returns PID count, not byte count. Smoke checked own RSS and a known sleeping child. wait4 usage.ru_maxrss is bytes on Darwin; child64m control shows this OS maximum can reflect a child, so do not label it parent-only RSS.
